reviews.decision: The constructor type uses the locally owned historical options interface; its exported default-options token is separately a direct alias of the current peer token. The complete changed source and evidence transitions plus original review are preserved; previous constructor and runtime diagnostics are historical only. Animation-mode policy, compiled DI, peer-floor, native, browser, packed behavior and G11 remain separately unqualified.

The local constant is a direct alias of the actual current peer default-options token, correcting the prior review that called the token locally owned. Material 16 legacy reexported its then-peer token; this source alias does not demonstrate mixed-version provider behavior. The complete changed source and evidence transitions plus original review are preserved; previous constructor and runtime diagnostics are historical only. Animation-mode policy, compiled DI, peer-floor, native, browser, packed behavior and G11 remain separately unqualified.
